title: Ứng dụng báo tài xế đã đến, nhưng tôi chưa thấy tài xế.
englishTitle: The app says my driver is here, but I can't find them.
pronunciation: Ung dung bao tai xe da den nhung toi chua thay tai xe
summary: The app says my driver is here, but I can't find them.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Keep the screen open so someone can compare the pin, plate, and chat.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the app while you say it. The sentence points to a ride-app mismatch, so the helper can check the map, call the driver, or direct you to the right pickup spot.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Nearby follow-ups: What is the Wi-Fi password? and Do you sell SIM cards?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use it when the app status and the real pickup spot disagree. It fits hotel lobbies, airport pickup zones, mall entrances, and confusing curbside pins.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: The screen is part of the sentence. Let the other person read the driver name, plate, and map location before you add more English.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Go next to charger, Wi-Fi, eSIM, and map-fix phrases if the problem shifts from pickup confusion to phone help.
